statement: Blind annotation from the Beinecke scan alone (canvas labelled '70v (part)', the wheel with two fish; overview plus four full-resolution quadrants). A wheel: two scaled fish and two stars in the centre, a patterned band, an inner ring of 10 nude figures rising from tubs laid on their side, and an outer ring of 19 nude half figures standing in upright tubs with varied surface patterns, eight of them consecutive on the right side wearing blue head coverings. Every ring figure has a star on a thin line and a short label. Labels are assigned from line ids and unit codes only (19 + 10 + 1 label lines match 19 + 10 figures and one labelled centre star); the words were not read from the transcription. The starting point and direction are my assumption: clockwise, outer ring from the first figure right of a short stroke at about 11 o'clock, inner ring from the figure at the top. If the transcription starts elsewhere the label ids are rotated by a constant; the order of features round each ring does not depend on it.
